lead: `Core\Math::atanh` is not exactly odd, and the two legs disagree about which rows it fails on.
body: Every other member satisfies `f(-$x) == 0.0 - f($x)` bit for bit, but `atanh` takes a logarithm of an asymmetric expression, so MSVC and glibc miss on different magnitudes and a parity sweep fails on the other leg. Assert a *relative* agreement for that one member (`abs($there + $back) <= abs($there) * 1.0e-15`, the infinite row by exact equality).
